description: Angular component for OTA update management, including form handling, validation, and user notifications within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: OtaUpdateComponent
classes.description: Angular component for OTA package updates, handling form creation, validation, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up form value change subscriptions for URL validation and tag auto-generation.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if the delete option should be hidden based on table config.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the reactive form for OTA package data entry.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Populates the form with existing OTA package data.

methods.name: onPackageIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when package ID is copied.

methods.name: onPackageChecksumCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when checksum is copied.

methods.name: onPackageDirectUrlCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when direct URL is copied.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares form data for submission, removing or including fields based on URL type.
